checkpoint: Fixed final update; P1 also saves update 200 to audit identical optimization prefix. No validation checkpoint or contact-threshold selection.
physical_sampling: Same original/edited parent pairs and random stream in all cells; complete releases. Old training and validation parents are development evidence only.
P0: Original weighted CE divided by valid count, phase loss coefficient 0.1
P1: P0 with five times the updates and exposure
P2: P0 with weighted CE divided by applied class-weight sum
P3: P2 with exact-state phase inputs at identical sampled transitions; other objectives unchanged
P4: P3 with parent-uniform, phase-balanced local examples, class-average CE. Valid local-example count matches P3 per update; no inverse weights applied twice. Separate local random stream. This changes objective and sampling together.
evaluation: Natural prevalence on all nine validation branches and originals separately; raw, eligibility-masked, earliest-geometry and always-positive-with-eligibility scores; per-class confusion and independent-parent support; exact states and free rollouts. Threshold 0.5 fixed. Physical error/locality and ramp tails retained.
staging: Run seed 0 first. Complete all three seeds for the five inexpensive controls before representation changes. Future event/integrator/selector protocols will be frozen separately, before their new data/fits.
promotion: No automatic demo promotion. Phase metrics alone do not change physical integration. No final-data tuning or claims of calibrated natural probabilities after balanced sampling.
